text: make a website for my friend's south indian restaurant called Kaveri Kitchen in Pune. people should be able to see the menu with prices, filter it by veg and non-veg, see today's specials, book a table on whatsapp, find the address and opening hours, see photos of the dishes, and read a few customer reviews. it should feel warm and homely and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear brief. I need a few details about Kaveri Kitchen that only you or your friend would know.
Please send these: What are the WhatsApp number for table bookings, the full address in Pune, and the opening hours (including any closed days); Can you send the menu: dish names, prices, and whether each is veg or non-veg; Do you have real photos of the dishes and a few real customer reviews (reviewer name and what they said); What are today's specials, and how often do they change.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

WhatsApp for bookings: +91 00000 33333. Restaurant phone: +91 00000 44444. Address: 7 Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038. Hours: 8am to 10:30pm every day, kitchen closes 10pm. Menu with prices: Starters: Medu vada 120, Veg cutlet 140, Chicken 65 260. Mains: Masala dosa 160, Mysore dosa 180, Idli sambar 110, Veg thali 280, Chicken chettinad 340, Fish curry meal 360. Desserts: Payasam 100, Filter coffee 60. Veg items: all except Chicken 65, Chicken chettinad, Fish curry meal. Today's specials: Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal. Reviews: "Best dosa in Kothrud" - Anita R.; "Feels like home" - Vikram S.; "Great filter coffee" - Neha P. Booking: tables for 1 to 8 people, book by WhatsApp with name, date, time and number of people. Nothing is on offer or discounted right now. Pictures: no photos yet, show empty photo spots.
@Requester Thanks, I have everything I need. The team is starting on the Kaveri Kitchen site now, with empty photo spots until real pictures are ready.

@Adaptation Charter is recorded. Propose workflows for a single-file site for Kaveri Kitchen using only the facts in the charter. Do not invent dishes, prices, offers, photos or reviews. Photos are empty labelled spots. Specials are static (Mysore dosa, Fish curry meal), kept in one easy-to-edit list.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Nine small workflows, one per site section, total 105 of the 200 budget (rate card). The shell goes first so the sections have a page to sit in, and styling goes last so it covers everything. Every fact comes from the charter, and the photo spots stay empty.

proposal.name: Page shell, header and navigation
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists yet: no title, header, viewport tag or navigation.
proposal.expected_outcome: HTML skeleton with title and header 'Kaveri Kitchen', a viewport meta tag, and a nav linking to #menu, #specials, #booking, #photos, #reviews and #contact. Empty anchored section slots are left for the other workflows.
proposal.completion_check: Title and header contain 'Kaveri Kitchen'. The nav has six links, each pointing to an existing section id. The viewport meta tag is present.

proposal.name: Priced menu with veg/non-veg filter
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot see dishes, prices or veg status, and cannot filter.
proposal.expected_outcome: Menu section with the 11 charter dishes grouped as Starters, Mains and Desserts, each with its rupee price and a veg or non-veg tag. All, Veg and Non-veg buttons show only the matching dishes. Non-veg are Chicken 65, Chicken chettinad and Fish curry meal.
proposal.completion_check: Exactly 11 dishes with the charter prices are listed. Veg shows 8 dishes, Non-veg shows 3, All shows 11. No JS errors.

proposal.name: Today's specials
proposal.expected_outcome: #specials section listing Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal, read from one small easy-to-edit list in the script. No offers or discounts are shown.
proposal.completion_check: #specials shows exactly Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal, with no price cuts or offer wording.

proposal.name: WhatsApp table booking
proposal.expected_outcome: #booking section with a 'Book a table' button linking to a wa.me URL for 910000033333, with a prefilled message asking for name, date, time and number of people. The section states tables are for 1 to 8 people.
proposal.completion_check: The button href starts with https://wa.me/910000033333?text=, the message mentions name, date, time and number of people, and the text '1 to 8 people' is on the page.

proposal.name: Dish photo spots
proposal.expected_outcome: #photos section with empty labelled photo spots (plain bordered boxes with dish names) and no images or stock photos.
proposal.completion_check: #photos has labelled empty spots and the file has no img tag or external image URL.

proposal.name: Customer reviews
proposal.expected_outcome: #reviews section with exactly three reviews: 'Best dosa in Kothrud' by Anita R., 'Feels like home' by Vikram S., and 'Great filter coffee' by Neha P. No ratings or other text are added.
proposal.completion_check: #reviews contains exactly three review cards with the charter text and reviewer names, and nothing else invented.

proposal.name: Address, hours and phone
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot find where or when.
proposal.expected_outcome: #contact section with the address 7 Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038, the hours 8am to 10:30pm every day with kitchen closing at 10pm, and the phone +91 00000 44444 as a tel:+910000044444 link.
proposal.completion_check: #contact has the exact address, hours and kitchen-close text, and a tel:+910000044444 link.

proposal.name: Footer and content hygiene
proposal.goal_gap: Nothing yet guarantees the file stays free of offers, discounts and placeholder text.
proposal.expected_outcome: Footer section with the name, city and a link back to the top. It has no offer, discount or placeholder wording, and no lorem ipsum or TBD anywhere in the file.
proposal.completion_check: The file has no 'lorem', 'TBD', 'offer', 'discount' or '% off' text, and the footer is present.

proposal.name: Warm look and responsive layout
proposal.goal_gap: Sections are unstyled and may overflow on phones.
proposal.expected_outcome: Site-wide CSS with a warm palette (turmeric, terracotta, cream), readable type and tap-friendly buttons of at least 44px. Mobile-first layout rules, with a breakpoint for wide screens and no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px.
proposal.completion_check: At 360px and 1280px, scrollWidth equals clientWidth, and buttons and links are at least 44px tall.
